description: Source code for the ContactsService class implementing contact querying and addition functionalities using the Contacts framework in Swift.

classes.name: ContactsService
classes.description: A final class that provides contact search and add functionalities, interacting with the system Contacts framework.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for contacts matching the given parameters, returning a payload of matching contacts.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new contact with provided parameters; handles existing contact conflicts.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and returns whether contact store access is authorized, with special handling for different authorization statuses.

methods.name: authorizedStore
methods.description: Returns an authorized CNContactStore instance, or throws an error if permission not granted.

methods.name: normalizeStrings
methods.description: Trims whitespace from string arrays and optionally lowercases them.

methods.name: findExistingContact
methods.description: Searches for existing contacts matching given phone numbers or emails to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: matchContacts
methods.description: Matches contacts against provided phone numbers and emails to find duplicates.

methods.name: normalizePhone
methods.description: Normalizes phone numbers to digit-only strings for comparison.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Converts a CNContact into an OpenClawContactPayload data structure.

methods.name: _test_matches
methods.description: Test utility to check contact matching logic in debug mode.
